title: The fun account
note: Erfundene Beispielgeschichte (Composite), keine echten Kundenzahlen. Zahlen sind in sich konsistent: 38 Wins / 24 Losses / 6 Breakeven = 61% Win Rate, AvgWin 96 vs AvgLoss 233 -> Profit Factor 0.65 -> Netto -1.944 USD.
caption:
He was up 38% on the fun account by March. By June it was gone.

The win rate was never the problem: 38 wins against 24 losses reads 61%. The average win was $96 and the average loss was $233 — a profit factor of 0.65 and a net of -$1,944. Nothing about that shows up in a strategy. It shows up in position size, and only if someone is writing it down.

Same setups, half the size after two losses, 90 days logged: 71 trades, 57%, profit factor 1.41.

Composite example — a story assembled from common patterns, not a real customer. The figures illustrate the feature, not real trader results.
